preconditions.expression: t == int(stdin.split()[0]) and t >= 1 and t <= 10**4
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 10^4) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 2 * 10**5 for n in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first line after t is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 2·10^5) representing the number of points to visit.

preconditions.expression: all(len(r_line.split()) == n and all(1 <= int(r) <= 10**9 for r in r_line.split()) for r_line, n in zip(stdin.splitlines()[2::2], [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]]))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the second line contains n integers r_i (1 ≤ r_i ≤ 10^9) representing the layer numbers of the points.

preconditions.expression: all(len(c_line.split()) == n and all(1 <= int(c) <= int(r) for c, r in zip(c_line.split(), r_line.split())) for c_line, r_line in zip(stdin.splitlines()[3::2], stdin.splitlines()[2::2]))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the third line contains n integers c_i (1 ≤ c_i ≤ r_i) representing the point positions in their respective layers.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(zip(r_line.split(), c_line.split()))) == n for r_line, c_line in zip(stdin.splitlines()[2::2], stdin.splitlines()[3::2]))
preconditions.description: All n points in each test case are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout_line.split()) == 1 and stdout_line.split()[0].isdigit() for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: For each test case, output a single integer representing the minimum cost of a path passing through all points in arbitrary order.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(stdout_line) <= sum(max(0, abs(r1 - r2) + abs(c1 - c2) - 1) for (r1, c1), (r2, c2) in itertools.combinations(zip(r_line.split(), c_line.split()), 2)) for stdout_line, r_line, c_line in zip(stdout.splitlines(), stdin.splitlines()[2::2], stdin.splitlines()[3::2]))
postconditions.description: The output cost for each test case is non-negative and does not exceed the sum of pairwise Manhattan distances between points (adjusted for triangle structure).

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout_line) == min_cost for stdout_line, min_cost in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [compute_min_cost(r_line.split(), c_line.split()) for r_line, c_line in zip(stdin.splitlines()[2::2], stdin.splitlines()[3::2])]))
postconditions.description: The output cost for each test case is the minimum possible cost to traverse all points in arbitrary order, starting from (1, 1), where cost is defined as the number of edge flips required to make all points reachable in some order.
